title: Anthropic turns qualitative interviews into an AI-assisted research workflow
friendlyTitle: Claude can help researchers interview many people
summary: Anthropic has detailed Interviewer, a Claude-powered research tool that helps teams plan studies, conduct adaptive multilingual interviews and synthesize themes with researcher review. Anthropic says it has used the system in studies ranging from 1,250 professionals to a pilot involving almost 81,000 people across 159 countries and 70 languages.
friendlySummary: Anthropic’s Interviewer helps plan questions, hold flexible interviews in many languages and find common themes. Human researchers review and interpret the results.
whyItMatters: Conversational AI can make large qualitative studies faster and broader than conventional interviews, but the analysis still depends on informed consent, representative recruitment and human interpretation. Businesses could apply the pattern to customer or employee research without mistaking automated synthesis for an objective verdict.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could make customer and employee research faster. People must still agree to take part, and humans need to check whether the sample and conclusions are fair.
